notes: Read SKILL.md and references/microinteraction-patterns.md, references/scroll-animations.md, references/animation-libraries.md in full. The skill gives motion/microinteraction guidance (timing, easing, loading states, toasts, gestures, scroll and page transitions, reduced-motion handling) with React/Framer Motion, GSAP, Web Animations API and CSS samples.
No commands, installs, credentials, or network access; everything is front-end code for the user's own app (sample fetch/api calls such as api.toggleLike are illustrative placeholders).

SKILL.md does not link to the three reference files; they are self-contained supplements. references/animation-libraries.md:291 uses GSAP's SplitText plugin, which historically required a GSAP Club licence for the user's project (now free); this concerns the user's dependency choice, not the skill's text.
